reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed; the rendered text is identical to the original, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Ono is the Licensee (our party alias) and Array the Licensor/counterparty, so Section 14.3's liquidated damages — a royalty-rate reduction triggered by Array's breach or data concealment — run in our favour, which the rule's detection guidance expressly treats as compliant.

The rationale correctly distinguishes the Section 7.1 late-payment interest (a mutual, market-rate commercial interest charge) from a Customer-payable penalty or minimum/early-termination fee, and confirms Article XIV imposes only wind-down obligations, supporting the preferred position of no Customer-payable LDs.
Cited paragraphs support the conclusion; no deterministic check failures and no over-flagging.
